article.linkText: SEC matchup features No. 23 Missouri against Arkansas
article.story: No. 23 Missouri (5-2) at Arkansas (3-4), Oct. 31 at 7:45 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Missouri by 10. Against the spread: Missouri 3-4, Arkansas 3-4. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Missouri Offense Overall: 430.3 yards per game (36th in FBS) Passing: 268.3 yards per game (30th) Rushing: 162.0 yards per game (61st) Scoring: 31.1 points per game (54th) Missouri Defense Overall: 330.6 yards per game (44th in FBS) Passing: 226.6 yards per game (95th) Rushing: 104.0 yards per game (21st) Scoring: 19.6 points per game (31st) Arkansas Offense Overall: 343.0 yards per game (106th in FBS) Passing: 231.4 yards per game (66th) Rushing: 111.6 yards per game (122nd) Scoring: 21.0 points per game (114th) Arkansas Defense Overall: 357.7 yards per game (66th in FBS) Passing: 213.0 yards per game (75th) Rushing: 144.7 yards per game (75th) Scoring: 26.7 points per game (96th) Arkansas is 112th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 42.9% of the time. Missouri ranks 60th on offense, converting on 41.4% of third downs. Missouri ranks 20th in the FBS with a +5 turnover margin. Missouri ranks 123rd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75.0% of trips. Team leaders Missouri Passing: Austin Simmons, 1,773 yards, 14 TDs, 2 INTs, 63.2 completion percentage Rushing: Jamal Roberts, 867 yards on 167 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Cayden Lee, 669 yards on 46 catches, 5 TDs Arkansas Passing: K.J. Jackson, 1,444 yards, 7 TDs, 4 INTs, 60.9 completion percentage Rushing: Braylen Russell, 205 yards on 58 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Chris Marshall, 633 yards on 43 catches, 2 TDs Last game Missouri fell 31-3 to Ole Miss on Oct. 17. Simmons led Missouri with 339 yards on 25-of-44 passing (56.8%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Roberts carried the ball 20 times for 39 yards, adding two receptions for 21 yards. Donovan Olugbode had nine receptions for 127 yards. Arkansas won 31-21 over Vanderbilt on Oct. 17. Jackson led Arkansas with 251 yards on 21-of-31 passing (67.7%) for no touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 11 times for 58 yards and one rushing touchdown. Russell had 51 rushing yards on 14 carries, adding two receptions for two yards. Antonio Jordan had five receptions for 74 yards. Next game Missouri hosts No. 11 Texas on Nov. 7. Arkansas plays at Auburn on Nov. 7.
